title: trace

atoms.evidence: stride = mat.stride() — queries the matrix's per-dim strides as the basis for the diagonal walk
stride[0] + stride[1] = row + col stride; produces the diagonal — this IS the diagonal-via-strides atom in its canonical 3-line form

notes: Minimal 3-atom strided-memory exercise — the worked example for diagonal-via-strides. Tight scope. Validates that diagonal-via-strides is genuinely distinct from contiguous-layout + as-strided-windowing (you need to KNOW that summed strides walk the diagonal — pure geometric insight).
